notes.title: October 15 Version Update
notes.content:
Hello, players!

Recently, I’ve received a lot of valuable feedback from all of you, and I sincerely appreciate your support and passion! In this playtest update, I’ve added Japanese and Korean language support, along with several adjustments and optimizations based on player feedback. As an indie game developer, I will continue to update the game and actively address any issues players encounter to provide a better gaming experience. Here are the detailed updates for this version:

[h2]New Additions:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a transparency setting for summoned creatures.
[*] Added a one-click sell feature for equipment.
[*] Added a survey link.
[*] Added support for Japanese and Korean.
[/list]
(If you encounter any translation-related issues, please join our Discord and provide feedback.)

[h2]Optimizations/Adjustments:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Bosses will now have a super armor effect when casting skills (they won’t be stunned or paralyzed).
[*] Disabled camera horizontal follow in the starting room.
[*] Reduced the gold cost for reforging certain quality equipment.
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the paralysis chance for the Lightning Mage was incorrect.
[*] Fixed an overlapping issue in the talent descriptions.
[*] Fixed a bug where the controller would stop working after resetting talents.
[/list]
The game is still in development, so if you enjoy it, please add it to your Steam wishlist. I also welcome you to join the community to share your thoughts and suggestions, as I look forward to chatting with you directly. Thank you again for your support!

Enjoy the game!
